doan_van.noi_dung: Last summer, my friend Mai and I planned an exciting journey to London. Before we left, I made a reservation online for our accommodation. I wanted to book a comfortable room for two nights near the city centre. When we arrived at the airport, we had to show our passports and collect our boarding passes. The airport was very busy, so we had to carry our heavy luggage carefully. There was an announcement that passengers must keep their bags with them at all times. Unfortunately, there was a short delay, but the plane finally departed two hours late. When we reached the hotel, we walked to the reception desk to check in. I asked the polite receptionist if any quiet rooms were available on the top floor. She checked her computer and gave us a key for a lovely room. She explained that breakfast was included every morning, so we did not have to pay extra. In fact, we did not have to pay now because we had already paid online, but we left a small deposit for the key card. The receptionist kindly reminded us that guests must not smoke anywhere inside the building. Finally, we asked what time we had to check out on Sunday morning. She told us eleven in the morning, which was perfect for our schedule. Our wonderful holiday started very well, and we enjoyed every minute of our stay in the city.

phat_am:
- **luggage** /ˈlʌɡɪdʒ/ — trọng âm đầu, đuôi /ɪdʒ/.
- **available** /əˈveɪləbl/ — 4 âm tiết, trọng âm âm thứ 2.
- **must** trong câu nói nhanh thường bị nuốt âm /t/: *You must go* → “you mus’ go”.
luu_y:
**① mustn’t ≠ don’t have to — khác biệt sống còn.**

- **mustn’t** = **cấm**, không được phép: *You mustn’t tell anyone.* (cấm nói)
- **don’t have to** = **không cần**, tùy bạn: *You don’t have to tell anyone.* (không nói cũng được)

> Người Việt hay dịch cả hai thành “không phải…” và dùng nhầm, gây hiểu sai hoàn toàn.

**② must không có dạng quá khứ** — phải mượn **had to**:
❌ I musted go. → ✅ I **had to** go yesterday.

**③ Sau must → V nguyên thể; sau have to → V nguyên thể.**
❌ I must to go. ❌ She have to go. → ✅ I must go. / She **has to** go.

**④ luggage / baggage không đếm được:** ❌ two luggages → ✅ two **pieces of** luggage.

**⑤ trip / journey / travel / voyage:**

- **trip** = chuyến đi (có mục đích, đi rồi về): a business trip
- **journey** = hành trình di chuyển: a long journey
- **travel** = động từ, hoặc danh từ **không đếm được** nghĩa chung: ❌ a travel
- ❌ I had a good travel. → ✅ I had a good **trip**.

**⑥ book vừa là danh từ (sách) vừa là động từ (đặt chỗ).** *I booked a table.*
meo:
- **mustn’t = “cấm” · don’t have to = “khỏi cần”** — dịch bằng 2 chữ Việt khác hẳn nhau để không lẫn.
- must = luật **trong đầu tôi** (tôi tự thấy phải làm); have to = luật **bên ngoài** (quy định bắt tôi làm).
- Nhóm không đếm được của du lịch: **luggage, accommodation, information, money** — 4 từ này người Việt hay thêm “s” nhất.
